[[Category:Senate Motion]][[Category:381YE Autumn]]
__NOTOC__
<ic>To recognise the House of Guiscard as rulers of Kalino.<br><br><i>Proposed by Segura, Seconded by Skarsind.</i></ic>
===Overview===
* This motion announces formal support to the Iron Confederacy house of Guiscard in their bid to become rulers of Kalino, following on from a [[Recognise ducal quality|similar motion]] during the Summer Solstice 381YE.
* Passed
===Date===
* Autumn 381YE
===Campaign Outcome===
* This statement by the Senate has no legal implications but may have diplomatic consequences.
